name: gpt-image-2-6
description: Guide to OpenAI's GPT Image 2.6 on varg (gpt_image_2_6) and the entry point to the GPT Image 2.6 skill set: Flare vs Sunburst, quality vs reasoning_effort, sizes and aspect presets, what fal rejects (xhigh and max effort, SVG, over 16 GIF frames), measured prices, failure modes, the exact varg MCP and REST calls, and prompt recipes for the text-heavy layouts people shared on X: infographic, product launch poster, photo to editorial travel print, photo to Baroque gallery poster, landmark postcard, character turnaround sheet, storyboard sheet and low-res to clean upscale, each credited to its author. Use when someone asks for GPT Image 2.6, gpt-image-2.6, Flare or Sunburst, wants an infographic, poster, art print, character sheet or storyboard with readable text, or asks how to prompt, size or price this model. Not for looping GIFs (gpt-image-gif), sticker packs (gpt-image-sticker-pack), game sprite sheets (gpt-image-sprite-sheet), circle-and-arrow edits (gpt-image-markup-edit) or video (varg-ai).
